reason: The hypothesis directly restates the synergistic inhibition mechanism and experimental outcomes already reported in P14 and P26, proposing the same intervention (anodic polarization in WO42−/MoO42− solution) on the same material (Q235 steel) to achieve the same predicted result (suppressed pitting via an enriched passive film). It adds only a pre-treatment step before chloride exposure, which is a minor procedural variation of the existing study.

formation of Fe2(WO4)3 and Fe2(MoO4)3 passive film
reduced defect density measured by Mott-Schottky
